{{Quote|Lieutenant, the 501st is headquartered just down the road&hellip; Sir, this ship is assigned to Sergeant Two-Two&mdash;|A clone trooper, to a disguised Dass Jennir|<ref name="Dark Times 2" />}}
'''Two-Two''' was a [[clone stormtrooper]] who served as a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[203rd Division]].<ref name="Dark Times 2" /> A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Two-Two was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="CloneDB" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the 203rd, including Two-Two, was stationed at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the planet [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. Shortly following the [[Cleansing of New Plympto]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] was [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] Two-Two's [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing starfighter]] when [[Dass Jennir]],<ref name="Dark Times 2" /> a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survivor of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="Dark Times 1">[[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]]</ref> arrived at the spaceport. Disguised as a [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone Lieutenant]], Jennir approached the unsuspecting clone. Upon noticing the "[[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]," the clone explained that the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Two-Two, to which Jennir kicked the clone in the head and stole the fighter.<ref name="Dark Times 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Two-Two was mentioned in the [[Dark Times 2|second issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' comic series, which was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Dark Times 2" /> on [[January 24]], [[2007]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/13-729/Star-Wars-Dark-Times-2--The-Path-to-Nowhere|text=Star Wars Dark Times 2: The Path to Nowhere}}</ref> The comic's story and script were written by [[Randy Stradley]]<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|127|Blaster}}</ref> under the pseudonyms Welles Hartley and Mick Harrison, respectively.<ref name="Dark Times 2" />
